text:
maya (Design): Quick design review request — looking for feedback on the compact scrubber + sampling indicator prototype. Mock: https://redwood.design/frag/scrubber-sample?ver=2 :link:

alex (Frontend): Can you summarize the user problem? Is this about too much visual density or the misunderstanding about sampled vs full metrics?

maya (Design): Both. Two things we're trying to solve: 1) at small widths the p95 badge + heatmap scrubber compete for space, 2) users don't realize the heatmap is based on sampled traces at high-retention ranges and assume it's full data. We want a lightweight indicator + clarifying microcopy.

jon (Observability): Re: sampled vs full — we've had support tickets where customers hit a p95 discrepancy when zooming. If we add a badge saying "sampled" users will still ask why numbers differ. Any thoughts on toggling to "full compute" on demand?

sam_ops: Backend note: full p95 on arbitrary range is expensive unless we precompute rollups. We can offer an async "Compute full p95" action that queues a job and shows ETA, or show an approximate online aggregation (p2, p50, p95 sketch) that improves accuracy.

rachel (A11y): Accessibility nits: color-only heatmap cues are hard for low-vision / colorblind folks. If we add pattern overlays (diagonal lines, dots) for bucket intensity, ensure they're toggleable and exposed to `prefers-reduced-motion` and high-contrast modes. Keyboard users should be able to toggle sampling info via a single key and read results via `aria-live="polite"`.

alex (Frontend): Implementation thoughts: compact scrubber layout would collapse the p95 pill into an icon that expands on hover/focus. For sampled state, microcopy options: "Showing sampled data (1 in 10 traces) — view full compute" vs "Estimated from sampled traces — request exact". Which reads clearer?

maya (Design): Prefer shorter: "Showing sampled results — request full computation". In the UI we'd shorten to `Sampled` on the badge and show the full sentence in a tooltip/expand panel. Also propose a subtle warning tone (amber) not red.

design-bot: Proposed copy diff:
```
- "p95: 123ms"
+ "p95: 123ms  ·  Sampled"
+ tooltip: "Showing sampled results (1/10 traces). Click to request full computation."
```

jon (Observability): UX question: should the heatmap legend include a tiny indicator for sampled density? e.g., a hollow dot vs filled depending on whether bucket is sampled-heavy. Could be noisy.

rachel (A11y): Legend idea ok if paired with `aria-describedby` and an accessible explanation panel. Also ensure contrast ratio for amber + text meets 4.5:1 for small text; if not, use icon + text.

alex (Frontend): Technical ask: if we add pattern fills, our canvas-based renderer needs an extra draw pass — perf impact might be noticeable. Alternative: overlay an SVG pattern layer for higher-contrast modes only. I'll prototype both.

maya (Design): Decision proposal:
- show compact `Sampled` badge in compact scrubber
- clicking badge opens a panel with: sampling ratio, "Request full computation" button (async), brief explanation copy
- heatmap: default color palette, optional pattern overlay in A11y / high-contrast mode
- keyboard: `S` toggles sampling panel when scrubber focused; panel updates via `aria-live`

sam_ops: +1 to async job approach. Need to design guardrails (rate limit requests per org). I'll add API spec: `POST /compute-full-p95` returns job id and ETA.

maya (Design): Next steps: alex to spike compact scrubber + tooltip copy, rachel to mock pattern overlay and validate contrast, sam_ops to draft API and guardrails, jon to coordinate QA testcases (example traces). I'll file follow-ups. @alex @rachel @sam_ops @jon :eyes:

alex (Frontend): On it — will drop a prototype by EOD Tue. :thumbsup:

rachel (A11y): I'll run the pattern overlay through colorblind simulator and keyboard flow tests, expect initial notes tomorrow.

jon (Observability): I'll compile a short regression test checklist for p95 differences and sampling ratios.

maya (Design): Thanks everyone. Leaving this open for small copy tweaks. If nothing else by Friday I'll merge the microcopy and start handing off assets. :sparkles:
